title: Citation Cop
blurb: Flag claims that their quoted source does not support.
lesson: Checking a claim against a source is a close race, which shows the trade-off between speed and care.
why: Each claim comes with its source text. One Noul question asks whether the source supports the claim. Jev answers with a probability.
The LLM reads the same pair. The race is usually close, so the lesson is in the time and cost columns as much as in accuracy.
